ငှ,ညှနှမှယှရှလှ
အရှေ့ ရွာမှာ ဘာရှိသလဲ။
လူစည်ကားလှပါသည်။
လှည်းစီး၍ လာကြသည်။
လှေစီး၍လည်း လာကြသည်။
လူကလေး မှေးနေသည်။
အအေးမိ၍ နှာစေးသည်။
စပါး လှေ့နေကြသည်။
စပါး ပေါ်မှ အလှူပေးမည်။
အမှားအမှန် ခွဲခြားပါ။
သတိ ရှိရမည်။
သနားညှာတာမှု ရှိကြပါ။
What is in the eastern village?
It is very crowded.
Is there a pagoda festival?
They come by cart.
They also come by boat.
The child is napping.
He has a cold and runny nose.
Is there an inhaler?
Keep him warm.
They are threshing paddy.
Chew roasted beans for a snack.
Pour some plain tea.
We will donate from the paddy harvest.
Seek knowledge.
Distinguish right from wrong.
You must be mindful.
Be compassionate.
ဘယ်ရွာမှာ လူစည်ကားသလဲ။  --- အရှေ့ရွာ
ဘယ်သူက မှေးနေတာလဲ။  --- လူကလေး
ကလေးတို့မှာ အမြဲတမ်း ဘာရှိနေရမလဲ။  --- သတိ
ဘယ်လိုစိတ်မျိုး ထားရှိကြရမလဲ။  --- သနားညှာတာမှု ရှိရမည်
ဘယ်အချိန်ကျမှ အလှူပေးမှာလဲ။  --- စပါးပေါ်မှ
In which village is it bustling? --- The eastern village.
Who is dozing off? --- The little boy.
What festival is there in the eastern village? --- Pagoda festival.
What medicine is asked for a runny nose? --- Inhaler.
What are the people winnowing? --- Paddy.
What should be chewed for a snack? --- Roasted peas.
What is requested to be poured? --- Green tea.
What should be strived for and acquired? --- Knowledge.
Why does the little boy have a runny nose? --- Because he caught a cold.
What must you be able to distinguish? --- Right and wrong.
What must children always have? --- Mindful awareness.
How do they come to the pagoda festival? --- They come by riding bullock carts and boats.
How is the little boy instructed to stay? --- To stay warm.
What kind of mindset should one have? --- Must have compassion and sympathy.
When will the donation be made? --- When the paddy is harvested.
When will the donation be made? --- When the harvest comes in / After the paddy is yielded.
